description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Arc' that renders an animated elliptical arc using SVG. It uses hooks like useState and useVideoConfig, and references functions and constants related to rendering an arc with gradient stroke styling and animation based on progress, rotation, and colors.

methods.name: getCircumferenceOfArc
methods.description: Calculates the circumference length of an elliptical arc based on radii rx and ry.
